translations.web: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
translations.bsb: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
translations.kjv: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
translations.asv: Heal me, O Jehovah, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
